points.text: Strongly adaptive regret appears to imply the bound via simple reduction; novelty and challenge claims overstated
Proof gap in Lemma 1: key inequality goes the wrong way for n>=32
Sloppy constants, conditions and notation errors in proofs and abstract
Proofs of Theorems 2 and 4 largely inherited from Zhang et al.; new content short
No lower bound or discussion of optimality of sqrt(log T) price
Lambda range excludes very short effective windows
Requires known horizon T and bounded losses; no anytime version
Per-round computational cost and memory not discussed
No empirical evidence or simulations, despite stock-prediction motivation
Related work thin: universal methods like MetaGrad not compared
Experiments compare SOGD only with OGD; adaptive or meta-learning baselines missing
Bounds depend on constants and assumptions; may be impractical and costly at scale
DNP-cu combiner seems unnecessary; discounted-measure mismatch issue overstated
Exponential step-size grids and iterative expert combination already established
No discussion of OCO with unbounded memory (Kumar et al. 2023)
Algorithm 3 hard to read; equations should be inline
Differences from Zhang et al. 2022 insufficiently discussed
Practical motivation for unknown lambda not concrete
Extension to time-varying lambda not addressed
